mail/imap_command_reading#

Reading every response of one command up to its tagged completion.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let read = await ImapCommandInput(origin: socket, tag: tag, prefix: bytes, limits: ImapCommandLimits()).read();
read.require_success().responses();

Description#

Reading every response of one command up to its tagged completion. The command channel uses it.

NO and BAD are completions to handle, not failures of the connection. BYE, a wrong tag, an unexpected continuation, the end of input or a limit leave the connection unusable. By default a command may draw 4096 responses and 64 MiB.

object ImapTag#

object ImapTag

One serialized command's output, including unsolicited responses. No command is sent here. The caller supplies its exact expected tag and owns the stream. NO/BAD are completed outcomes, not transport failures. BYE, unexpected tags, continuation, EOF, cancellation or limit failure require discarding alignment.
